text:
Alicia: Quick sync — need to lock invite funnel metrics + a short playbook for handling declines. Goal: 6 active design partners by EOW, pipeline of ~20 invites. What acceptance rate should we target and what's our re-engagement cadence?

Liam: Acceptance rate depends on list quality. If we source from product leads + existing contacts, 30-40% is realistic. Cold outreach will be lower (~10-15%). For timing, I'd do: initial invite, follow-up at day 3, final nudge at day 7. If declined, mark "soft decline" and re-engage at 6 weeks.

Matt: From eng onboarding POV, we need clear gating: 1) can they run a 1-hour integration test, 2) share logs/feedback, 3) optionally provide sample data. If someone accepts, we should have a lightweight onboarding checklist run in 48h. Also can we batch enable feature flags for partners? :thinking_face:

Sara: Agree on cadence. For feedback loops — prefer short weekly 30min check-ins for the first 3 weeks then biweekly. Use a shared Notion + a short recording after each sync. For interviews, here's a minimal guide we can reuse:
```
- 3 quick questions: goal, current workflow, blocker
- 2 product tasks: run prompt X, check latency/quality
- 1 open ask: what would make this 2x better?
```

Jay: Success criteria suggestions: time-to-first-successful-call (<=48h), 3+ meaningful queries/day (or equivalent metric for their workflow) within 2 weeks, qualitative NPS >=7 after 30 days. Also track dropout reasons in a single column so we can triage patterns.

Kate: Quick legal note — NDA + POC terms should be a one-pager. If we use a standard mutual NDA it should be signed before we ship any customer sample data. Aim for legal turnaround <=3 business days for the template.

Alicia: Putting together a one-pager playbook draft, capturing: audience segments, invite cadence, templates, onboarding checklist, decline flows, and success metrics. Draft plan below (comments welcome):

```
invite_funnel_v1:
  target_segments: ["platform-ops", "search-product", "AI-features"]
  target_acceptance_rate: "30% (warm), 12% (cold)"
  cadence_days: [0, 3, 7]
  reengage_after_days: 42
  onboarding_sla_hours: 48
  initial_metrics: ["time_to_first_call","queries_per_day","qual_nps"]
```

Liam: +1 to that. Also add a risk flag for partners who require heavy infra changes — tag them as "high-touch" and treat separately (longer SLAs).

Matt: Will add a small script to toggle a partner feature-flag and a template for sending basic telemetry so we can measure latency/throughput on day 1. ETA for scripts: 3 days.

Sara: I'll draft the interview template + a short in-product survey (3 Qs) that fires at day 7.

Jay: I'll own the outreach cadence and tracking sheet. Suggests these decline categories: (1) timing, (2) compliance/legal, (3) no dev bandwidth, (4) moved to competitor. We should send a tailored one-click "reconsider" email at 6 weeks with a short product update.

Kate: I'll prep the NDA + POC one-pager today and post it in the doc.

Alicia: Awesome. Next steps: I’ll circulate the draft playbook by EOD, Matt + Liam to confirm onboarding scripts + feature flag plan by Thu, Sara to share UX templates by Fri, Jay to start first outreach batch on Mon. If anyone sees blockers, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
